technique_name: Write a business proposal outlining an SEO strategy for a small business
description:
This business proposal outlines an SEO strategy for a small business to improve their online visibility and reach their target audiences. 

The SEO strategy will be focused on optimizing existing content and website structure, such as internal linking structure and meta tags, to put the store ahead of their competitors in organic (unpaid) search results. example: The business is a shoe store.
